notes: Height and bulk sheet 10H (Dec. 1995). One heavy frame rule (~9 px) on left, top and right; the bottom edge sits just above the thick bar (~24 px) that rules off the full-width legend and title strip (README rule 3: the strip, with the planning-code note, north arrow, scale bar and sheet number in it, is outside, so there is no remove polygon). No corner arcs, no notches beyond the full-width strip, no SECTION badge. The cross-references 'SEE SHEET 8H' (top), 'SEE SHEET 11H' (left) and 'SEE SHEET 9H' (right) float inside the frame and stay inside (rule 4); district codes, COUNTY LINE and street names are map. The page is turned slightly (top rule drifts ~11 px down left to right). No ink under the outline. Each side's inner edge was measured every 5 px along the side (the dark run of the rule in a 3-px band, runs wider than the rule's median width replaced by outer edge + median width), smoothed with a +-60 px running median, and the outline set ~2.5 px inside it (README rule 1), points every ~200 px; corners where straight fits of the last 300 px of the two sides meet. Every vertex checked on full-resolution close-ups.
